question: Which are ways a financial institution can manage a frozen asset account? (Choose two.)

options.A: Charge interest to interesting-bearing accounts at a normal interest rate.
options.B: Add interest to a frozen interest-bearing account at a normal interest rate.
options.C: Charge interest to a frozen account at a higher-than normal interest rate as a form of payment.
options.D: Add interest to interesting-bearing accounts at a lower-than-normal rate.
options.E: Charge interest to a frozen account that would normally have interest charged.

question: How does the EU’s Best Practice Guidance differ from OFAC Guidance regarding sanctions due diligence and beneficial ownership? (Choose two.)

options.A: OFAC’s rule blocks an entity when a sanctions target controls or exercises influence over an entity.
options.B: OFAC’s rule does not include aggregated ownership.
options.C: OFAC’s rule applies when a sanctions target owns more than 40% of a legal entity.
options.D: The EU’s rule applies when a sanctions target owns more than 50% of a legal entity.
options.E: The EU requires that assets be frozen when a sanctions target controls or exercises influence over an entity.

question: An OFAC-designed person owns 60% of Entity A and 30% of Entity B. Entity A owns 25% of Entity C. Entity B owns 20% of Entity C. Which entity(ies) should be considered sanctioned according to the OFAC 50% rule?
When applying a risk-based approach to creating a sanctions compliance program, a Sanctions Compliance Officer should include which elements in an evaluation of the business?

options.A: Level of revenue generated by the company’s largest customers
options.C: Companies in its supply chain and the geographies they operate in
options.D: Level of regulatory enforcement in the foreign locations in which the company operates

community_answer: C. Companies in its supply chain and the geographies they operate in

question: After completing an investigation with the decision that no sanctions violation occurred, the best way to document the investigation is in accordance with:

A Sanctions Compliance Officer conducts an investigation into an alert of a possible sanctions list match and determines that the alert is a true match to the sanctions list. Which step should the Officer take next?

options.A: Prepare a report for the applicable regulator notifying them of the situation.
options.B: Review the particular sanctions program restrictions applicable to this sanctions target.
options.C: Close any accounts related to the sanctions target.
options.D: Request that funds associated with the sanctions target be frozen/blocked.

community_answer: B. Review the particular sanctions program restrictions applicable to this sanctions target.

question: Which considerations should be taken into account when conducting sanctions due diligence on insurance companies as customers? (Choose three.)

options.A: Are the company’s brokers required to do sanctions checks on individuals for whom it underwrites policies?
options.B: How many brokers and intermediaries does the company employ?
options.C: What is the maximum payout figure for an investment-based insurance product?
options.D: How many products does the company offer overall?
options.E: In which jurisdictions are its products and services offered?
options.F: What are the company’s procedures for identifying the beneficiary owner(s) of its customers?

question: In sanctions investigations, social media: (Choose two.)

options.A: is a way to exchange information on sanctioned parties.
options.B: provides information relating only to individuals’ private lives.
options.C: is easily accessible and can offer reliable sources of information.
options.D: can be used to identify possible relations between different parties.
options.E: can serve as a secondary source of information to provide leads for further investigation.

question: Company X exports goods to the US. One of Company X’s three directors is also the 100% shareholder and has recently been designated as a sanctions target by OFAC. The night before designation, the shareholder resigned from the director role and transferred 25% of his shares to his spouse, as well as 26% to a company that is managed by a trust in which he is one of the beneficiaries. Which tactics are being used to evade the sanctions restrictions that apply to the shareholder?

A tanker ship approaches the Persian Gulf reporting that is probably empty. It then vanishes from the tracking grid. Six days later, the ship reports back that it is riding with full tanks. Which evasion technique did the ship use?
community_answer: C. Disabling the Automatic Identification System (AIS)
